verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs describe exactly this: natural-language act/click/type primitives with vision+DOM understanding that operate on sites 'never seen before' and fall back to selectors only if needed (skyvern-docs-19, skyvern-gh-1, skyvern-docs-17), positioned explicitly as a replacement for brittle Selenium scripts (skyvern-docs-13). However, a hands-on community test found it worked on the happy path but concretely failed to interact with a layout element (a popup) and struggled to hit a tab on a real site (skyvern-comm-2), contradicting the claim that it robustly survives arbitrary layout changes. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on selector/layout-change robustness, broader corroboration beyond one hands-on report, and resolution of the observed failure mode.
